Madre e hija

Silvia & Brenda.

Chef Silvia Aguilera and her daughter Brenda brought the botanas of Culiacán, Sinaloa, to the Kennewick waterfront. Their truck opened at Columbia Gardens in September 2022, right by the pond and the cable bridge.

Fruit cut fresh, chamoy and chili-lime on everything, and the kind of snacks you eat with your fingers on a sunny afternoon.

Botanas al estilo Culichi, hechas por una madre y su hija.
